bore_m.source: https://www.os-engines.co.jp/english/line_up/engine/air/aircraft/catalog/17750.htm; manufacturer bore specification converted from mm to m

stroke_m.source: https://www.os-engines.co.jp/english/line_up/engine/air/aircraft/catalog/17750.htm; manufacturer stroke specification converted from mm to m

rod_to_crank_radius_ratio.source: NITRO-03 explicit unmeasured slider-crank geometry estimate; connecting-rod length / crank radius = 3.5; matched internal dimension unavailable

reciprocating_mass_kg.source: NITRO-03 explicit unmeasured equivalent-mass estimate: 2.5% of manufacturer dry engine mass (550 g); 1–5% sensitivity retained in vibration evidence; no matched component measurement; https://www.os-engines.co.jp/english/line_up/engine/air/aircraft/catalog/17750.htm

mechanical_torque_nm.source: NITRO-01 candidate assumption; unmeasured and not physically validated; MAX-61FX: 55AX law scaled by displacement 9.95/8.93 (equal rated BMEP 526.7 vs 525.1 kPa); docs/research/glow-engines/NITRO-61FX/README.md

combustion_efficiency.source: NITRO-01 candidate assumption; unmeasured and not physically validated

delivery_ratio.source: build_profiles.py NITRO-61FX-R2: os_max_61fx_candidate delivery x (1 - 0.209341 (rpm/13000)^2), held beyond 20000 rpm; k solves wide-open brake torque 0.679225 N m at 13000 rpm, the installed anchor (Dave Gierke, Model Airplane News 05/2003 ".60 engine shootout", O.S. 61FX with its stock muffler: 1.24 hp at 13,000 rpm, "most muffler equipped .60 make their maximum HP output at around 13,000 RPM" (secondhand: RC Universe thread 1638558, 2004-03-21; the article itself was not found); mechanical hp). Check: Glassock 2012 (QUT PhD) rig: an O.S. 10 cc FX on a 12x6 at 30 m/s turned 11,000 rpm with 0.617 N m shaft torque through a geared motor (extra friction); references/rc-throttle-power/. Back pressure modelled as a wide-open-throttle function of rpm only (part-throttle derate overstated); not a measured map

indicated_efficiency.source: build_profiles.py: independently inferred WOT torque knots + estimated gas-exchange/loss curves; ONLY rated-power knot constrained by https://www.os-engines.co.jp/english/line_up/engine/air/aircraft/catalog/17750.htm; MAX-61FX: 55AX torque knots and losses scaled by displacement 9.95/8.93 (equal rated BMEP 526.7 vs 525.1 kPa); docs/research/glow-engines/NITRO-61FX/README.md
